note: Official trophy names and descriptions are shown exactly as PlayStation publishes them. Every guide below is written in this guide's own words and names the published guides it draws on. No video links and no external URLs appear anywhere in this guide: it is fully self-contained and works offline. A trophy whose method is not yet confirmed says so plainly instead of guessing.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum is the reward for everything else: it pops automatically the moment the other 54 trophies are earned, so there is no separate task to do for it. Treat this guide as the checklist for it. Finish the story, clear the stranger strands, sweep the collectibles and activities, and grind the 100% completion requirements — the tracker on the Guide tab shows exactly what is left.
steps: Finish all five story chapters and the final mission.
Complete the 8 stranger mission strands.
Sweep collectibles: cards, WAiNK spots, vehicles, full map.
Clear activities, challenges and the crime trophies.
Reach 100% completion — the platinum pops with the last trophy.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: A story trophy that cannot be missed: it unlocks when you finish the Chapter 1 mission Gone Fishing, the game's early fishing introduction with Lucia and Jason. Just play through the opening chapter and follow the mission markers. The mission also teaches the fishing mechanics you will need later for the fishing challenge against Cal.
steps: Play through Chapter 1 until Gone Fishing appears.
Follow the on-screen objective to the fishing spot.
Complete the mission's fishing sequence.
The trophy pops at the mission-complete screen.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 1. Nothing optional is required — the chapter trophy unlocks at the final mission's completion screen. If you are mopping up side content, do it after the chapter ends so the story pace stays clean.
steps: Play the Chapter 1 mission chain in order.
Complete the chapter's final mission.
The trophy unlocks automatically.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 2. Chapter 2 is where the stranger strands and several side activities open up, so it is a good moment to start the missable meditation spots and the early activities — but the chapter trophy itself only needs the story missions done.
steps: Play the Chapter 2 mission chain in order.
Complete the chapter's final mission.
The trophy unlocks automatically.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 3. This chapter opens the Cartel Heist and several stranger finales, so expect longer, louder missions. The trophy unlocks at the end of the chapter's final mission — no side content required.
steps: Play the Chapter 3 mission chain in order.
Complete the chapter's final mission.
The trophy unlocks automatically.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 4. The chapter includes the VCIA Takedown and the Headliners and Child's Play missions, each with its own trophy, so several trophies will pop along the way. The chapter trophy itself unlocks at the final mission.
steps: Play the Chapter 4 mission chain in order.
Complete the chapter's final mission.
The trophy unlocks automatically.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: One of only two gold trophies: finish the final mission of Chapter 5. Before you start it, clear the one missable trophy in the game — meditate at every spot for Positive Mental Attitude — because some meditation spots become unavailable once the story ends. Stock up on armour and ammo, then play the finale; the gold pops at the credits.
steps: Before the finale, finish Positive Mental Attitude (the only missable).
Stock armour, ammo and snacks.
Play and complete the final mission.
The gold trophy pops at the mission-complete screen.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 2 story mission Breakfast Run. It is a straight story unlock — follow the mission markers, complete the objectives, and the trophy pops at the end. No special approach or loadout is needed.
steps: Reach Breakfast Run in the Chapter 2 mission chain.
Complete the mission objectives.
The trophy unlocks automatically.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 3 story mission The Cartel Heist, one of the game's big set-piece heists. Expect a multi-stage job: get in, grab the take, and get out under pressure. Bring a solid weapon loadout and armour; the mission's own checkpoints carry you through, and the trophy pops at the end.
steps: Reach The Cartel Heist in the Chapter 3 mission chain.
Follow the heist stages to completion.
The trophy unlocks automatically.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 4 story mission Child's Play. A straight story unlock — play the mission through its objectives and the trophy pops at the mission-complete screen.
steps: Reach Child's Play in the Chapter 4 mission chain.
Complete the mission objectives.
The trophy unlocks automatically.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 4 story mission Headliners. It is a louder, combat-heavy mission, so go in with armour and a full ammo stock. The trophy pops when the mission completes — no optional objective is required for it.
steps: Reach Headliners in the Chapter 4 mission chain.
Complete the mission objectives.
The trophy unlocks automatically.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 4 story mission VCIA Takedown, the airport takedown job. Expect heavy resistance on the tarmac and a getaway sequence. Use cover, keep moving, and let the mission checkpoints do their work — the trophy pops at mission complete.
steps: Reach VCIA Takedown in the Chapter 4 mission chain.
Complete the mission objectives.
The trophy unlocks automatically.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 5 story mission Operation Savage Glory, a late-game operation near the end of the story. Go in stocked and expect a long firefight. The trophy pops at the mission-complete screen, right before the finale run.
steps: Reach Operation Savage Glory in the Chapter 5 mission chain.
Complete the mission objectives.
The trophy unlocks automatically.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The second gold trophy and the real platinum gate: reach 100% completion in the in-game stats. Everything counts — all story missions, all 8 stranger strands, the collectible sets, the activities, the challenges, the stunts and the exploration. Open the pause-menu checklist often; it is the only honest progress bar for this trophy. Do the missable meditation trophy before the finale, then grind the long tail in Phase 2 and 3 of the roadmap: 250 stunts, 50 challenges, all races, all cards and all WAiNK spots are the usual last items.
steps: Finish the story and all 8 stranger strands.
Complete the collectible sets: cards, WAiNK spots, vehicles, full map.
Clear activities: 20 race wins, drone races, shooting-range gold, 50 challenges.
Finish the 250 stunts and the crime trophies.
Watch the in-game completion stat hit 100% — the gold pops.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Land 250 stunt jumps across Leonida. Stunt jumps are the marked ramps and jumps scattered through the map — the game counts a jump when you hit the ramp, get air, and land cleanly. A fast bike is the best tool: it accelerates quickly, turns tight, and recovers fast after a bad landing. Work region by region so you do not re-drive the same jumps, and tick them off in the tracker as you clear each area. Failed landings do not count, so slow down on the approach if you keep bouncing.
steps: Grab a fast bike and full armour.
Hit marked stunt ramps region by region.
Land cleanly — a crash or bail does not count.
Keep count in the tracker; 250 jumps is a long grind, split it over sessions.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.official: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Sample every activity type in the game at least once — you do not need to win or finish anything, just try each one. The activity types are fishing, the arcade, the shooting range, racing, Top Fun drone racing, bowling and meditation. Most of them open in Chapter 1 or 2, so this is a good early-game trophy: knock it out while the map is still opening up and it doubles as a tour of everything the game offers.
steps: Fish once at any fishing spot.
Play one arcade game.
Try the shooting range once.
Enter one race and one drone race.
Bowl one frame and meditate at one spot.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.official: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Gold-medal every challenge at the shooting range. Each challenge scores accuracy and speed against a fixed target set, so the trick is not raw speed — it is clean, deliberate shots. Slow down, aim for the centre mass of each target, and reload only between waves. Repeat a challenge until the gold threshold clicks; the range lets you retry instantly, so treat each run as practice for the next one.
steps: Open the shooting range and work through each challenge.
Aim deliberately — accuracy beats speed for the gold score.
Retry a challenge immediately until gold pops.
Clear every challenge at gold to unlock the trophy.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.official: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every race location on the map. Each location has its own course with its own gates and shortcuts, so fly the course once slowly to learn the line, then race it for real. Cut corners through the gates where the course allows it, and save the boost for the long straights. A win at each separate location counts — check the tracker so you do not re-race a location you already won.
steps: Find each Top Fun drone race location on the map.
Fly the course once to learn the gates and shortcuts.
Race to win at that location.
Repeat at every location until all are won.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — replays of the same race do not count, so you need 20 distinct events. Mix the race types: street races, off-road, and any other race series the map offers. A tuned car in the right class makes most races comfortable; if a race keeps beating you, drop a class or pick a shorter event and come back later. The race markers stay on the map, so work through them in batches.
steps: Open the race markers across the map.
Win 20 distinct race events — no repeats.
Tune your car to the race class if you keep losing.
Track which races you have won in the checklist.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.official: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal, the fishing rival, in a head-to-head fishing challenge. This is a contest of catches, not luck: pick the right bait for the spot, cast where the fish are showing, and keep the line tension steady when a fish bites — too much tension snaps it, too little lets it off. Cal's score is the target; a couple of solid catches usually beats him. The fishing basics from Gone Fishing apply directly here.
steps: Find Cal's fishing challenge marker.
Pick bait suited to the spot.
Keep line tension in the safe zone on every catch.
Outscore Cal to win the challenge.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish any one arcade game at an arcade cabinet. Walk up to a cabinet, start a game, and play it through to its end screen — you do not need a high score, just a completion. It is one of the quickest trophies in the game and pairs naturally with Master of None.
steps: Find an arcade cabinet.
Start any arcade game.
Play it through to the end screen.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.official: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's stranger mission strand by playing its final mission. Andy's missions unlock as you progress through the story — each one appears as a stranger marker on the map. Play them in order until the strand's finale appears; the trophy pops when that last mission completes. Andy's strand counts as one of the 8 needed for Strangers & Freaks.
steps: Find Andy's stranger marker when it appears.
Play each of Andy's missions in order.
Complete the strand's final mission.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.official: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's stranger mission strand by playing its final mission. Kenton's strand is boat-heavy and opens early, in Chapter 1 — follow the stranger markers as they appear and work through his jobs in order. The finale is the last of his missions; complete it and the trophy pops. It also counts as one of the 8 strands for Strangers & Freaks.
steps: Find Kenton's stranger marker when it appears.
Play each of Kenton's missions in order.
Complete the strand's final mission.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.official: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's stranger mission strand by playing its final mission. Billy's jobs are biker-flavoured and open in Chapter 2. Follow the stranger markers, play his missions in order, and the finale unlocks the trophy. It also counts as one of the 8 strands for Strangers & Freaks.
steps: Find Billy's stranger marker when it appears.
Play each of Billy's missions in order.
Complete the strand's final mission.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.official: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 full stranger mission strands across Leonida. The known strands are Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and Bret, plus two more that open as the story progresses. Stranger markers appear on the map as you move through the chapters — play each strand to its finale and the silver pops when the eighth one completes. This is a Phase 3 trophy: most strands only fully open in Chapters 3 and 4, so do not chase it early.
steps: Play the story until stranger markers appear.
Work each strand to its final mission: Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, Bret and two more.
Complete the eighth strand's finale — the silver pops.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.official: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's stranger mission strand by playing its final mission. Randy's jobs open in Chapter 3 and revolve around moving product around Leonida. Follow the stranger markers, play his missions in order, and the finale unlocks the trophy. It also counts as one of the 8 strands for Strangers & Freaks.
steps: Find Randy's stranger marker when it appears.
Play each of Randy's missions in order.
Complete the strand's final mission.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.official: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's stranger mission strand by playing its final mission. Tyrone's jobs open in Chapter 3. Follow the stranger markers, play his missions in order, and the finale unlocks the trophy. It also counts as one of the 8 strands for Strangers & Freaks.
steps: Find Tyrone's stranger marker when it appears.
Play each of Tyrone's missions in order.
Complete the strand's final mission.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.official: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: THE ONE MISSABLE TROPHY — read this first. Meditate at every meditation spot across Leonida, and do it before you finish the story: some spots become unavailable after the finale, and this is the only trophy in the game that can be locked out of a playthrough. Meditation spots are quiet scenic points marked on the map; walk to one, start the meditation, and let the short sequence finish. Work through them as the map opens — Chapter 1 already has spots available — and tick each one off in the tracker. Do not leave this for post-game.
steps: Start meditating in Chapter 1, as spots open.
Visit every meditation spot on the map and complete the sequence.
Tick each spot off in the tracker as you go.
Finish all spots BEFORE the final mission.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.official: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: LEAD — reported by the community, not yet fully confirmed. Bret's stranger strand includes a hunt: track and take down a unique animal he names. Hunting in Leonida means reading the environment — tracks, calls and the hunting sense — then a clean shot with a scoped rifle. Approach downwind, move slowly, and take the shot only when the animal is still. Treat the exact animal and location as a lead until a second published guide confirms it; the tracker marks this trophy as a lead for that reason.
steps: Open Bret's stranger strand in Chapter 2.
Follow Bret's hunting jobs in order.
Track the unique animal with the hunting sense and take a clean shot.
If the hunt does not trigger, finish Bret's other missions first and return.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 full collectible card sets. Cards are hidden all over Leonida — tucked into shops, on rooftops, in alleyways and off the beaten path — and each set needs every card in it. You only need 3 complete sets for the silver, not every card in the game, so pick the sets whose cards cluster near places you already visit and finish those first. The tracker checklist helps you avoid re-checking spots you have already cleared.
steps: Pick 3 card sets to target first.
Sweep their card locations region by region.
Complete all cards in each chosen set.
The silver pops when the third set completes.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK feature at 100 different locations across Leonida. WAiNK spots are the photo and check-in points scattered through the world — landmarks, viewpoints, murals and oddities. Open the WAiNK prompt at each spot and register it; each location counts once. The best approach is to WAiNK everything you pass while doing the story and the other sweeps, so the 100 builds up naturally instead of becoming a separate grind at the end.
steps: WAiNK at every spot you pass during the story.
Sweep remaining landmarks region by region.
Each location counts once — 100 total.
The silver pops at the 100th location.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges from the in-game challenge list. Challenges span combat, driving, flying, exploration and activities, and many complete themselves while you play the story and the other trophies. Open the challenge menu regularly and chase the cheap ones first — short, repeatable tasks you can finish in minutes — then work the longer ones in batches. Fifty sounds like a lot, but the count climbs fast once you start targeting it.
steps: Open the challenge menu and sort by easiest.
Clear the quick challenges first.
Let story and sweep play complete the rest naturally.
The trophy pops at the 50th completed challenge.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.official: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level and then lose it. Get the cops' attention — a robbery or a shootout works — until the fourth star lights up, then break line of sight and hide with your partner until the heat dies. Alleys, parking garages and the outskirts work better than open roads; a fast car with a clean escape route helps. The trophy pops once the wanted level fully clears while your partner is still with you.
steps: Bring your partner along.
Raise heat until you hit 4 stars.
Break line of sight and hide until the stars clear.
The trophy pops when the wanted level is gone.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.official: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row without letting the wanted level drop. Pick three shops close together, hit them in quick succession, and keep the heat alive between robberies — the wanted level must not clear between shop one and shop three. A fast getaway car parked outside each shop keeps the chain moving. If the wanted level drops, the chain resets and you start over.
steps: Bring your partner and pick 3 shops close together.
Rob the first shop and keep the wanted level.
Hit the second and third shops back-to-back.
The trophy pops after the third robbery.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 distinct vehicles. A vehicle counts as discovered when you get in it or drive it — variety is what matters, not distance. Cruise different districts and try everything parked on the street: sedans, trucks, bikes, boats and aircraft all count toward the total. The count builds naturally during the story, so just make a habit of hopping into anything new you see.
steps: Drive or enter any vehicle you have not used before.
Vary the districts — different areas park different vehicles.
Check the tracker count as you go.
The trophy pops at the 100th distinct vehicle.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.official: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during one single use of Combat Focus, the slow-motion aiming mode. Pick a fight with at least 5 enemies in the open — a gang hideout or a wanted-level shootout works — then trigger Combat Focus and chain the kills while time is slowed. Aim for quick centre-mass shots and do not let the focus meter run out before the fifth kill. If you only get four, let the fight reset and try again.
steps: Find a fight with 5+ enemies in the open.
Trigger Combat Focus.
Chain 5 takedowns before the meter ends.
The trophy pops on the fifth kill.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.official: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure from Vice City International Airport: get into a plane on the tarmac and take off without a flight plan. The airport is restricted, so expect a wanted level the moment you cross the fence — go in fast, grab a plane, and get airborne before the response builds. Any runway works; once the wheels leave the ground the trophy pops.
steps: Head to VCIA with a fast approach in mind.
Cross onto the tarmac and take a plane.
Take off from any runway.
The trophy pops once you are airborne.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Get behind the controls of a Rhino tank and make some heat — the description's joke is the clue. Rhinos show up at military sites and during high wanted levels. Once you are in one, the tank's cannon and armour do the talking: roll through a wanted-level response or a military cordon and the trophy pops. Do not stay on foot around it — the tank is the point.
steps: Find a Rhino at a military site or during high heat.
Get in and take control.
Use the tank in combat.
The trophy pops once the tank run registers.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.official: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store clean — no detection at all. Go at night, move slowly, and stay out of the cameras' cones and the staff's line of sight. Smash or grab the cases quickly once the floor is clear, then leave before anyone raises the alarm. If a single guard or camera spots you, the attempt fails: leave, let the heat die, and try again with a slower route.
steps: Pick a jewelry store and scout it at night.
Stay out of camera cones and sight lines.
Grab the goods and leave undetected.
The trophy pops once you are clear.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one. Bank vaults are the big scores: crack the vault, grab the take, and break the wanted level before the next one. Plan each hit — a fast car, an escape route away from the bank, and a hiding spot to cool off. You do not need to do all five in one run; each completed vault-and-escape counts, so work them one at a time.
steps: Pick a bank vault target and plan the escape route.
Crack the vault and take the score.
Escape and lose the wanted level.
Repeat for 5 vaults — the silver pops on the fifth escape.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.official: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and get away clean. Armored trucks run set routes around Leonida — intercept one, stop it, crack the rear doors, and grab the cash. The guards will fight back and the truck's alarm brings the cops, so hit it fast and have a getaway car ready. Once the cash is yours, break the wanted level to finish the job.
steps: Find an armored truck on its route.
Stop it and crack the rear doors.
Grab the cash and get to a getaway car.
Lose the wanted level to complete the robbery.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Visit every region of Leonida so the whole map is revealed. The state is bigger than Vice City alone — the map covers the city, the Keys, the swamps, the farmland and the coast. Drive or fly through each named region until the map fills in; the pause-menu map shows which areas are still fogged. This pairs well with the WAiNK and vehicle sweeps, since both take you to the same far corners.
steps: Open the map and note the fogged regions.
Travel through each region until it reveals.
Cover city, Keys, swamps, farmland and coast.
The trophy pops when the last region reveals.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.official: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each gang in Leonida. Every gang runs its own off-the-books operations — stash houses, labs, drop points — and you need to hit one per gang, not several from the same crew. Scout a target, hit it, grab the take and escape, then move to the next gang's turf. The tracker notes which gangs you have hit so you do not repeat one.
steps: Find an illegal operation on each gang's turf.
Rob one operation per gang.
Escape after each hit.
The trophy pops when every gang has been hit once.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.official: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to the Ocean Beach waterfront, find a bar or vendor with a view over the sand and the water, and order a cocktail. Sit back, watch the view, and the trophy pops — one of the most relaxing trophies in the game, and a good breather between the grind trophies.
steps: Go to Ocean Beach.
Find a bar or vendor with a waterfront view.
Order and enjoy a cocktail.
The trophy pops at the bar.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.official: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — drive straight through the showroom glass. Get into a car inside a vehicle showroom, line up on the big front windows, and floor it through the glass and out onto the street. Speed matters more than the car: a fast launch through the window is the classic move the description is asking for. The trophy pops the moment you burst out.
steps: Enter a vehicle showroom and get in a car.
Line up on the big front windows.
Accelerate hard through the glass.
The trophy pops as you smash out.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.official: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley: play a full game of bowling there. Rent a lane, bowl your frames, and finish the game — follow-through is the point, so complete the whole game rather than quitting halfway. It is quick, it opens in Chapter 2, and it is the same alley tied to the Ten Pin lead, so you will be back here anyway.
steps: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley.
Rent a lane and start a game.
Bowl every frame to the end of the game.
The trophy pops at the final frame.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Build your partnership up to mass appeal — the partner relationship trophy. Spend time doing activities with your partner: jobs together, dates, and the partner robberies all raise the bond. Keep your partner happy and active rather than leaving them behind, and the trophy pops when the partnership's appeal reaches its peak. It pairs naturally with Hot Together and Retail Therapy, which also need your partner along.
steps: Do activities and jobs with your partner.
Keep the partnership active across missions.
Raise the partner bond to its peak.
The trophy pops when mass appeal is reached.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make a defining choice — for better or worse. At a key decision point in the story, the game asks you to choose, and this trophy pops for the choice you commit to. There is no wrong answer for the trophy itself; pick the option that fits your playthrough and the trophy registers the decision. If you are following the story normally, this one comes to you.
steps: Play the story until a major choice point appears.
Make the choice and commit to it.
The trophy pops once the decision registers.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: UNKNOWN — no confirmed method yet. The official description ('Second time's the charm.') hints at failing something once and succeeding on the second try, but no published guide has confirmed the exact trigger as of this guide's writing, and this guide will not guess. What is known: it is a hidden bronze, and it is not tied to any story mission completion. Check the named source below for updates, and do not waste hours on unconfirmed theories.
steps: No confirmed steps yet — do not follow unconfirmed theories.
Check the source listing for a confirmed method.
This trophy is honestly marked unknown in the tracker.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Something strange is happening in Kelly County after 2am. Head out to the Kelly County countryside late at night — after 2am in game time — and look to the sky for the unexplained event the description is hinting at. Stay in the area and watch; the event triggers on its own once you are in the right place at the right hour. If nothing happens, the in-game clock may need to pass 2am again, so wait it out or return another night.
steps: Travel to Kelly County in the countryside.
Wait until after 2am in game time.
Watch the sky for the event.
The trophy pops when the event plays out.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.official: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: LEAD — reported by the community, not yet fully confirmed. The description points at the bowling alley: a melee drive-by at Kolt & Associates, knocking the pins — or the bowlers — over from a moving vehicle with a melee weapon equipped. Drive slowly past the lanes with a bat or similar melee weapon ready and swing as you pass. Treat the exact setup as a lead until a second published guide confirms it; the tracker marks this trophy as a lead for that reason.
steps: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley.
Equip a melee weapon and get in a vehicle.
Drive by the lanes and swing as you pass.
If it does not trigger, try a slower pass or a different lane.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.official: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from heists and big robberies — the Bank Vaults, the Cartel Heist and the armored trucks are good sources — and your contacts clean them into spendable cash for a cut. Keep laundering after every big score instead of sitting on marked bills, and the $250,000 total builds steadily. This pairs with the robbery trophies, so do them together.
steps: Collect Marked Bills from heists and robberies.
Launder them through your contacts.
Repeat after every big score.
The trophy pops at $250,000 laundered.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops in Leonida. Clothes, weapons, ammo, car mods, food — every shop purchase counts toward the total, and it adds up fast once you start buying gear properly. Do not hoard cash for this one: buy the weapons and upgrades you actually need, and the trophy will pop during normal play. If you are close, a big purchase at a car dealership or gun store finishes it.
steps: Buy gear you need: weapons, ammo, clothes, car mods.
Spread purchases across different shop types.
Watch the total climb.
The trophy pops at $100,000 spent.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase every garage property on the map. Garage properties appear as buyable markers once they open in Chapter 2 — each one costs money, so save up or sell off spare vehicles first. Buying them all also gives you storage across the map, which helps the vehicle collection. Check the map for any garage marker you have not bought yet; the last one is usually the most expensive.
steps: Find every garage property marker on the map.
Save up and buy each one.
Check for any marker left unbought.
The trophy pops when the last garage is yours.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.official: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Open the app on your in-game phone, then register vehicles you own or find — each registration counts once. Grab a mix of cars and bikes from around the map, register each one as you find it, and the trophy pops at the tenth registration. It pairs well with Whip It Good, since both reward trying new vehicles.
steps: Open the Scooter Bros app on your phone.
Register a vehicle you own or found.
Repeat for 10 different vehicles.
The trophy pops at the tenth registration.
